event.name: 30 October 2020 Samos earthquake, eastern Aegean Sea, Greece–Türkiye
event.tectonic_setting: Offshore NNE-dipping normal fault north of Samos, eastern Aegean back-arc extension.
event.region: Samos Island–İzmir, eastern Aegean Sea, Greece and Türkiye

reference.title: The 30 October 2020, M7.0 Samos Island (Eastern Aegean Sea) Earthquake: effects of source rupture, path and local-site conditions on the observed and simulated ground motions

inversion.method: Joint geodetic inversion of Sentinel-1 ascending/descending InSAR LOS deformation and static GPS offsets using positivity-constrained weighted least squares and Laplacian smoothing. Geometry grid search across position, strike, dip and rake. Figure 4a is the preferred variable-slip model.
inversion.green_function_model: Okada (1985) rectangular dislocations in an elastic homogeneous isotropic half-space.
inversion.notes: FIGURE-DIGITIZED, NOT ORIGINAL AUTHOR COEFFICIENTS. Figure 4a, printed page 4752 (PDF page 8), contains 20 columns × 10 rows of 2.5 km square patches over a 50×25 km N285°E strike, NNE-dipping 38° fault, with rake −80°. Published peak slip is described as about 2.5–3.0 m, published geodetic moment 3.3e19 Nm. The source paper does NOT supply numerical patch slip or a precisely located top-of-fault depth: top_depth_km=0.0 is a schematic display datum consistent with the cross-section, not a reported plane-top measurement; patch depths assume a planar geometry. Figure 4a is a plan/map perspective. The slip image was rectified using its rectangular corners to restore the ORIGINAL 20×10 lattice. Along-strike is measured from the EAST end toward WNW (positive strike 285°), and down-dip increases NNE from the shallow SOUTH edge. The map is a surface projection; reversing both display axes is essential to recover this geometry. Slip estimated from a 0–300 cm discrete colorbar by robust sampling, masking green aftershocks, grey slip arrows, colored hypocenter/aftershock stars, red mapped trace and black strokes. Two heavily obscured cells are interpolated and explicitly flagged in the companion QA CSV (r0c9, r5c9). Background pale-yellow cells are colorbar-near-zero compatible, but not reliable measurements of zero. Digitization resolution is coarse (commonly order 0.15–0.30 m or larger in obscured regions). This JSON uses nominal constant rake per paper geometry and cannot recover any subcell rake variation. Event origin time was aligned with an existing Samos catalogue record for automatic event grouping; hypocenter coordinates 37.888°N, 26.777°E correspond to the AFAD location convention and depth 16 km is the AFAD value used in Table 3.

provenance.compiled_by: Reconstruction of the published Akinci et al. (2021) Figure 4a using geometric map-view rectification and colorbar-calibrated cell sampling; see companion QA PNG and cell_QA CSV. These values are not author-supplied finite-fault coefficients.
